scope: Controlled rule fixtures using actual XP, checkpoint, allocation, automation and verified in-memory SaveStore transactions; not a natural progression or TapTap device claim
checked: four professions: real XP emits one aggregate level event, checkpoint auto spends exact budgets, real stats update, allocation never heals, verified save restores points
manual and other-stat investments preserved; second-chapter free unlock and skill budget remain valid
level80 caps and overflow validated; no gold/material cost, respec or healing
manual mode and manual takeover retain points; explicit automatic mode resumes allocation
idle walks back to its local checkpoint and retains mode after allocation
nearby physical loot is collected before starting the allocation detour
combat at checkpoint cannot auto allocate or interrupt defense
idle with no local checkpoint retains pending points and continues without cross-map travel or pause
ordinary XP without a new level creates no level effect; actual leveling and auto allocation trigger immediate save
